title: Large Monochromatic Components in Colored Random Graphs
summary: We study the size of the largest monochromatic connected component that must appear in any edge-coloring of a random graph. Let $G\sim G(n,p)$ with $p\gg 1/n$ and $p=o(1)$, and write $np=he^h$. We show that, with high probability, every $2$-edge-coloring of $G$ contains a monochromatic connected component of order at least $n-Θ(ne^{-h})$. Moreover, we construct colorings showing that this bound is best possible up to constant factors.
